newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporate debt flat, Ohio Ed, Centerior stir.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporate debt flat, Ohio Ed, Centerior stir.

text.p: Divergent spreads of Ohio Edison Co and Centerior Energy Corp dominated an otherwise quiet U.S. corporate bond session on Monday, traders said.
Anchor Glass Container debt sank into the single digits in high-yield trade, meanwhile, following the announcement that the firm filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.
Topping high-grade action, debt of Ohio Edison widened about 30 basis points following news the firm will merge with Centerior Energy Corp via a stock for stock transaction.
